episodes.196674: A series of cold fronts and a polar trough increased moisture and instability across the region for the last three days of October. Moisture levels went well above the climatological value, leading to a significant increase in showers and thunderstorms. Showers were very numerous, with rainfall accumulations surpassing 8 inches in sectors of northeastern and southeastern Puerto Rico. Soils were saturated, and rivers were running very high, triggering the issuance of a Flood Watch. With the excessive rainfall, multiple flash flooding events and mudslides unfolded.

events.narrative: Emergency management reported a fallen tree on PR-101 at km 0.4. The road was impassable.
Broadcast media shared a photo on social media showing that Calle Monserrate in Hormigueros was flooded. However, cars were still able to pass through, albeit with difficulty.
